sources.note: Main website. Overview of products (EHR, PM, RCM, Patient Portal, AI tools), specialty focus (allergy, pulmonology, ENT, infusion), company awards, and customer testimonials.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists WISE 10.0 certification, 15 CMS quality measures, certified partners (phiMail, Updox, DrFirst Rcopia4, Carefluence), fee structures for e-prescribing and Direct messaging, and 'no known limitations' statement.
EHR product page. Describes flexible documentation, e-prescribing, patient dashboard, lab integration (Quest, LabCorp), specialty workflows, telemedicine, and integrated revenue management.

Practice management product page. Describes scheduling, eligibility verification, appointment reminders, check-in, billing/RCM, financial reports, timesheets, custom forms, digital signatures, patient messaging.

Company page. Founded mid-1990s by two physicians, launched ~2000. Milestones: 2011 MU Stage I, 2014 MU Stage II + first AAAAI Registry EMR, 2016 first OpenAPI cert, 2018 telehealth, 2021 acquired by Silverstone Capital. 300+ practice locations, 10M+ records.

Allergy/immunology specialty page. Detailed features: skin test orders/results, custom allergens, extract orders/vial mixing, injection administration, immunotherapy management, USP 797 compliance, AAAAI QCDR, spirometry, remote monitoring, biologic administration.
ENT allergy specialty page. Multi-specialty templates for otolaryngology + allergy + audiology, MQT algorithm support, skin testing, immunotherapy, ENT-specific billing codes.
Pulmonology specialty page. Spirometry integration/trending, ACT scoring, vital signs trending, sleep study questionnaires, DICOM/PACS integration, biologic administration, remote patient monitoring.
Patient portal (Hale Hub) page. Appointment scheduling, prescription refills, statements/payments, lab results, secure messaging, demographic updates, mobile app (iOS/Android).
Infusion center management page. Automated scheduling, check-in, EHR integration, billing/coding, insurance verification, regulatory tracking, secure patient portal for infusion records.

Richmond Allergy & Asthma case study. Real-world usage: doubled revenue in 8 months, 98% clean claim rate, 94% net collection rate, 60% transcription cost reduction via JOSH AI, integrated EHR+PM+RCM+SPOCK+InDrA deployment.
ITQlick review of ModuleMD WISE. Describes web-based EHR for practices of all sizes, e-prescribing, document management, scheduling, lab integration.
Capterra listing. User reviews mention good billing service, specialty focus for allergy/asthma, responsive support. Some mention integration challenges migrating from other EHRs.
G2 Summer 2023 High Performer recognition. 98-100% positive reviews, fourth consecutive award.
ACAAI 2025 showcase. Describes JOSH AI dictation (75+ languages, multi-patient), SkinSight AI (skin test image analysis), AI-powered ICD/CPT coding, and SPOCK front-office tool.
InDrA inventory management page referenced via search. Real-time stock levels, expiration alerts, immunotherapy/medication dispensing tracking, vendor/order management, smart forecasting.
Hale Hub iOS app listing. Patient portal mobile app by ModuleMD LLC — secure messaging, notifications, appointments.
